subject: biology
title: Stem cells
key_idea: A **stem cell** is an undifferentiated cell that can divide to make more cells and can differentiate into specialised cells. Stem cells are found in embryos, in adult animals and in plant meristems. Embryonic stem cells can become most cell types, but adult stem cells are more limited.

blocks.text: Stem cells are cells that have not yet become specialised. This section covers what they can do and where they are found.

items.meaning: An undifferentiated cell that can divide to make more cells, and from which other cells can arise by differentiation.
Not yet specialised for one particular job.
A stem cell changing into a specialised cell.
The tissue in plants that contains stem cells.

rows: Adult animals, such as in bone marrow
Many types of cell, such as blood cells
Tips of roots and shoots in plants
Any type of plant cell, throughout the life of the plant

items: Stem cells are undifferentiated and can differentiate into specialised cells.
Stem cells are found in embryos, in adult bone marrow and in plant meristems.
Meristem cells in plants can differentiate throughout the life of the plant.

blocks.text: Stem cells provide the new cells an organism needs. They work in two steps.

items.text: Stem cells divide by **mitosis** to make more cells.
Some of the new cells become specialised cells, such as blood cells, muscle cells or nerve cells.

items: In an embryo, stem cells form the tissues and organs of the developing baby.
In adults, stem cells make new cells for growth and to replace damaged cells.
In plants, the meristem at the tips of roots and shoots makes the new cells that let the plant grow.
Stem cells divide by mitosis, then the new cells can differentiate.
They provide new cells for growth and to replace damaged cells.
Plant stem cells are found in meristems.

blocks.text: The two types of animal stem cell differ in where they come from and what they can become.

rows: Adult tissues, such as bone marrow
Can be cloned and made to differentiate into most types of human cell
Bone marrow stem cells form many types of cell, including blood cells

checks.a: An undifferentiated cell that can divide to make more cells and can differentiate into specialised cells.

checks.q: Name the tissue in plants that contains stem cells and give one place where it is found.
checks.a: Meristem tissue, found in the tip of a root or the tip of a shoot.

checks.q: State one difference between embryonic stem cells and adult stem cells.
checks.a: Embryonic stem cells can differentiate into most (any) types of cell. Adult stem cells can only form certain types of cell.

worked_example.question: Scientists have developed patches of beating heart cells to repair damaged heart tissue. The patches are placed onto areas of the heart where cells have died. New cells grow to replace the dead cells. The patches are made using a person's own cells that are converted into stem cells. Explain why stem cells are used to make the patches.
answer_points: Stem cells are undifferentiated cells (they can differentiate into different types of cell).
Therefore they can form heart (muscle) cells.
worked_example.tip: "Stem cells can become specialised" and "stem cells are not specialised" are ignored. Use undifferentiated or can differentiate.

worked_example.question: Some animal cells are stem cells. Describe the function of stem cells.
answer_points: They make new cells (they divide, by mitosis).
They differentiate, becoming specialised or other (named) types of cell.
They provide new cells for growth or to replace damaged cells.
worked_example.tip: Any two score one mark each. Saying stem cells are unspecialised scores nothing.

worked_example.question: Stem cells can be obtained from embryos. Stem cells can also be extracted from menstrual blood. These two types of cells are different. Embryo stem cells can be used to treat a wider range of disorders than menstrual blood stem cells. Explain why.
answer_points: Menstrual blood cells are adult stem cells, which can only form certain types of cell.
Embryo stem cells can produce a wide range of cell types (any type of cell).
worked_example.tip: Name both types of stem cell and say what each can become.

worked_example.question: Describe what is meant by the term stem cell.
answer_points: The daughter cells can become specialised for specific functions.
worked_example.tip: Any two of the three points score a mark each.
